newsitem.title: JAPAN: Seiyu to open supermarkets in Shanghai - paper.
newsitem.headline: Seiyu to open supermarkets in Shanghai - paper.

text.p: Major Japanese supermarket operator Seiyu Ltd plans to open supermarkets specialising in food in suburban Shanghai, an economic daily said on Tuesday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Seiyu will open its first such store by next June and increase the number to at least to 20 outlets by the year 2000. Each store is expected to have 1,000 square metres of floor space, the paper said.
Seiyu will set up a joint venture with a Chinese partner in December, the paper said.
Seiyu was not immediately available for comment.
